name: ScrollIndicator
description: Animated affordance at the base of a hero that scrolls to the next section.

targetId.description: ID of the target element to scroll to; the control is omitted when absent

motion.description: Brief motion applied to the icon as a hint to scroll.

speed.description: Duration of one motion half-cycle, in seconds.

distance.description: Vertical travel of the bounce motion, in pixels (bounce only).

criteria.note: 2026-07-24 — promotion pass: real <button> with Enter/Space activation and a focus-visible ring; every motion preset (bounce/pulse/fade) is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion (falls back to a static, fully-opaque icon); forced-colors keeps the icon and focus ring visible; light and dark legibility confirmed in a real browser. AT snapshots captured across base/light/dark/forced-colors.

governance.note: Promoted to stable: consumed by HomeHero, ProjectHero, BlogHero and AboutHero. The variant/position/motion axes are prop-sourced (Tailwind conditional classes + a GSAP motion preset), not root CVA.
